title: Chunked file sync with a deadline budget
name: Chunked file uploader

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code enforces the overall time budget for a sync? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A 20 MB file is re-synced and all of its chunk hashes are already in knownChunks. What does the store see?
choices: Five putChunk calls followed by commitFile
Only a commitFile call listing all five chunks
Only a commitFile call with an empty chunk list

questions.prompt: A putChunk call rejects with a network error before its timer fires. What does handleSync do?
choices: Returns 504 with stage set to that chunk
Rethrows the network error to its caller
Skips the chunk and continues with the next one
Retries the chunk until the budget is exhausted

questions.prompt: A client sends clientDeadlineMs = 900000. What budget does the sync run with?
